source.prompt: (the chestnut-backed chickadee's) A chestnut-backed chickadee (Poecile rufescens), a tiny songbird about 11 cm long, one adult perched with its wings folded tight against the body, side-on pose. A round fluffy body, a big round head, a tiny short black bill, a medium-long narrow tail. A sooty dark brown cap and a black bib, bright white cheeks, a rich chestnut back and flanks, grey wings and tail, a white belly. Thin dark legs, three toes forward and one back. No base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: A variant of the chestnut-backed chickadee's Meshy preview (no credits), scaled to 0.14 m and pitched 30 degrees nose-up about the vent so it perches upright (the body about 45 degrees); the crown raised into a peak at the back and the bill broadened toward the tip (reshapes); a 6 cm square tail angled down as steeply as keeps its tip off the ground (raised from 62 to 19 degrees below level by the template's rule); a pale yellow eye ring behind each eye, set back so it reads as a teardrop. Colours: olive-green above, a pale yellowish throat, an olive breast, a yellow belly with olive-washed sides; dark wings with two buff wing bars (lod0 and lod1); the bill dark above and orange below; dark legs. Triangles: lod0 999 = 798 body + 201 legs, tail, cards, eyes; lod1 399 = 310 body + 89 legs, tail, cards, eyes; lod2 119 = 92 body + 27 legs, tail, cards, eyes. GLB 174,260 bytes. lod_m is a suggestion.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-05. Reads as an Empidonax: upright, olive and yellow, peaked crown, eye ring, wing bars, two-toned bill. Still open: on the ground the tail cannot hang as it does from a twig (the template keeps its tip above the ground), so it sticks back at 19 degrees below level; the body is the chickadee's, a little plump for a flycatcher; the teardrop eye ring is one octahedron, so the point behind the eye is soft.
